source.quote: Run every `checks[]` command in `.claude/standards.json`, in order, in the worktree. Run them; do not infer them.

prompt:
Set up: run git init, then create greeting.txt containing the line `hello`, lint.sh containing the two lines `echo ran >> .standards-ran` and `exit 0`, and .claude/standards.json containing `{"version": 1, "checks": [{"name": "lint", "command": "bash lint.sh"}]}`, and commit them as the first commit.

Task: change the line in greeting.txt to `hello, world`. Commit your work. Reply with the single word done.

checks.name: the worker ran the manifest's checks
the manifest's checks pass in the work directory
isolation: remove the repo and files so later evals in the shared work directory start clean (always passes)
